subject.title: [Bug]: plugin runtime subagent.run from before_dispatch does not trigger subagent_delivery_target or final external delivery

question: Should plugin-runtime `api.runtime.subagent.run()` support deferred external completion delivery, and if so should it be opt-in or the default?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but this changes public plugin-runtime semantics and can alter user-visible delivery for existing background plugin runs.

options.title: Add opt-in completion delivery
options.body: Introduce an explicit plugin-runtime option or mode that registers expected completion delivery and routes through the existing announce and delivery-target machinery.

options.title: Document background-only semantics
options.body: Keep plugin-runtime subagent runs detached by default and document that plugins must poll or handle completion themselves.

options.title: Make completion delivery default
options.body: Flip plugin-runtime subagent runs into expected-completion delivery by default, accepting the compatibility risk for existing plugins.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in completion delivery
recommendation.body: Introduce an explicit plugin-runtime option or mode that registers expected completion delivery and routes through the existing announce and delivery-target machinery.

likelyOwner.reason: This person committed the current gateway tracking behavior and is the strongest recent routing signal for the public default/API decision.
